name: Small Tripod Bowl (or Cup) with Tab Handle
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；8th-9th century；White stoneware with appliqué handle and feet and with dark brown glaze on the exterior and clear glaze on the interior. Place of manufacture uncertain--probably from northern China.
